scope: Whistler branch threading correctness. Does not establish integrated Service graph correctness or CNI activation.

regression.name: phi-threading-preserves-values-after-validation
regression.coverage: Merged values 1/102, initial 0/7, simple/nested validation, all combinations of selecting branch, validation success and nested check.

rootCause: phi-branch-threading bypassed the definition of a merged value still used after its conditional validation. Later PHI pruning substituted only the other predecessor value.
fix: Thread only when the bypassed block contains the branch and its PHI alone, and that PHI has no other users.
